title: WDD Validate Command
description: Implement the `wdd validate` command in `lib/wdd/cli.py` and `lib/wdd/validator.py`. It must load all schemas and validate every `.json` file in the mailbox and workorders directory against them.

requirements.execution: Walk the directory tree, parse the `$schema` reference in each JSON, load the target schema, and validate.
requirements.exit_code: Return non-zero exit code if any validation fails.

acceptance_criteria: `python -m wdd validate` runs successfully on a clean repo and fails if a malformed JSON is present.
failure_modes: FAIL: Silent failures when a schema is missing.
